Namely, under \pi_{\eta} one may generate the joint state as X\sim\mu\,,\hskip 20.00003ptZ\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I)\ 	ext{independently}\,,\hskip 20.00003ptY=X+\sqrt{\eta}\,Z\,. (2.7) Its X -marginal is \pi_{\eta}^{X}=\mu . Write \pi_{\eta}^{Y} for the Y -marginal, so that \pi_{\eta}^{Y}(\mathrm{d}y)\propto e^{-U_{\eta}(y)}\,\mathrm{d}y ; by ( 2.7 ), \pi_{\eta}^{Y}=\mu*\mathcal{N}(0,\eta I) is a Gaussian smoothing of the target. We use superscripts for marginal and conditional laws; in particular, \pi_{\eta}^{Y\mid X=x}=\mathcal{N}(x,\eta I)\,,\hskip 20.00003pt\pi_{\eta}^{X\mid Y=y}(\mathrm{d}x)\propto\exp\Bigl\{-V(x)- rac{\|x-y\|^{2}}{2\eta}\Bigr\}\,\mathrm{d}x\,.
